triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

First touch (R1205, 22:5xZ): **p1 · domain:server** → `pm:queue`.

Themes: zh-CN customers and MCP / 问数, with a named effect. Ordinary questions like 「按行业看销售额」 or "revenue this quarter" get an unneeded ask-back, because a grouping or time word with a near candidate stops a measure that matched exactly. Users meet that on common questions. So p1.

Reading taken: only dimension/time candidates change (offered as a grouping, never an ask); a word whose candidates are measures keeps today's behaviour (answer the matched measure, ask about that word) — that is what the card's Why and Done-when name; the literal first clause of Scope would also drop that ask, which this claim does not take.
Serial constraints cleared: #35100 (skill line, Tier H, open) teaches "follow nextStep's note" and stays true after this change; overlap-check before each push.

Lease `o1-C` (seat post #34366).

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Regraded p1 → p2: p1 is now kept for queue jumps.** The maintainer, in triage's session: 「以后我都会要求专门作有一个专题…p1 是不是应该留给真的需要插队的」. He then confirmed triage's review of every open p1 (「确认」). Development is dispatched by epic, and an epic orders its own work. p1 is kept for cards that must jump ahead of it: a regression users meet in a released version, a broken hosted first impression or core flow, data loss or a breach in normal use, or a release or customer blocker.

Why this card: a child of epic #34659 (ask line): the epic's structure orders it. Any claim on the card is unchanged.
